about: `node dist/node.js ops state --helper <version>` with the state snapshot of the helper on stdin (state_json in scripts/ops-helper.sh). Heartbeat only: stdout is not read beyond the exit code. The first snapshot below is what the helper of 0.9.0 (still version 3) sends; every key of it is kept by the app. The second is the snapshot after the helper took an update back because the app did not answer (watchdog_tick in scripts/lib/ops-watchdog.sh sends it at once): it adds `watchdog` {at, from, to, reason} (state_json reads ops/watchdog.frag, written by watchdog_report) and a doctor item with the id `watchdog` (watchdog_doctor_item), which has the five keys every item has. The app reads `watchdog` and does not keep it (parseWatchdog in services/ops-watchdog.ts), so that case does not set keepsStateKeys.

cases.name: a snapshot after the watchdog took an update back

items.title: Edellinen versio palautettiin, koska sovellus ei vastannut 10 minuuttiin
items.detail: Ylläpitoapuri vaihtoi itse version 0.9.0 takaisin versioon 0.8.7. Rivi poistuu seuraavassa tarkistuksessa.
